From b84bb7bd913d8ca2f976ee6faf4a174f91c02b8d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ming Lei <ming.lei@redhat.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jan 2026 22:48:08 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] nvme: fix admin queue leak on controller reset

When nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set() is called during a controller reset,
a previous admin queue may still exist. Release it properly before
allocating a new one to avoid orphaning the old queue.

This fixes a regression introduced by commit 03b3bcd319b3 ("nvme: fix
admin request_queue lifetime").

Cc: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Fixes: 03b3bcd319b3 ("nvme: fix admin request_queue lifetime").
Reported-and-tested-by: Yi Zhang <yi.zhang@redhat.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-block/CAHj4cs9wv3SdPo+N01Fw2SHBYDs9tj2M_e1-GdQOkRy=DsBB1w@mail.gmail.com/
Signed-off-by: Ming Lei <ming.lei@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/nvme/host/core.c b/drivers/nvme/host/core.c
index 83efc88ac0f9..c12986495e71 100644
--- a/drivers/nvme/host/core.c
+++ b/drivers/nvme/host/core.c
@@ -4860,6 +4860,13 @@ int nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set(struct nvme_ctrl *ctrl, struct blk_mq_tag_set *set,
 	if (ret)
 		return ret;
 
+	/*
+	 * If a previous admin queue exists (e.g., from before a reset),
+	 * put it now before allocating a new one to avoid orphaning it.
+	 */
+	if (ctrl->admin_q)
+		blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q);
+
 	ctrl->admin_q = blk_mq_alloc_queue(set, &lim, NULL);
 	if (IS_ERR(ctrl->admin_q)) {
 		ret = PTR_ERR(ctrl->admin_q);
-- 
2.34.1

### 修改总结

#### 1. 文件 `drivers/nvme/host/core.c` 中的修改

在函数 `nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set()` 中，新增了一段逻辑：在调用 `blk_mq_alloc_queue()` 分配新的 admin 队列之前，检查 `ctrl->admin_q` 是否已经存在（例如来自之前的控制器重置）。如果存在，则先通过 `blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q)` 释放该旧队列。

**具体代码变更**（位于 `core.c` 第 4860 行之后）：
```c
+   /*
+    * If a previous admin queue exists (e.g., from before a reset),
+    * put it now before allocating a new one to avoid orphaning it.
+    */
+   if (ctrl->admin_q)
+       blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q);
```

#### 2. 修改之间的关系

该修改具有明确的单一文件内逻辑关系：修复了因控制器重置时未释放旧 admin 队列而导致的资源泄漏问题。在先前的提交 `03b3bcd319b3` 中，admin 请求队列的生命周期管理出现了缺陷，导致每次调用 `nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set()` 时可能直接覆盖 `ctrl->admin_q` 指针而不释放原队列，造成队列对象被孤立（orphaning）。本次补丁通过在分配新队列前主动释放旧队列，确保了资源正确回收，从而消除了泄漏风险。

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
ctrl->admin_q = blk_mq_alloc_queue(set, &lim, NULL);
Reason:
During a controller reset, `nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set()` can be called when `ctrl->admin_q` already points to a valid admin queue from a previous allocation. Without releasing that existing queue via `blk_put_queue()` before assigning a new one, the old queue becomes orphaned, causing a memory/resource leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
+	if (ctrl->admin_q)
+		blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q);
Reason:
Adding this check and `blk_put_queue()` call ensures that any pre-existing admin queue is properly released before a new one is allocated. This prevents orphaning the old queue and fixes the leak that occurred during controller resets.
